**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What You Need | How It Works | |---------|---------------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to finish a round and by collecting the cards left in opponents’ hands. | The player who reaches the target score first wins the game. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Green, Blue, Yellow) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Draw Two”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | Shuffle the deck thoroughly. | | **Setup** | • Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. | If the first card is a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two,” the first player draws two cards and loses their turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players sit around the table; play proceeds clockwise. A “Reverse” card flips the direction. | The current player must match the top discard either by color, number, or symbol. | | **Playing a Card** | • If you have a matching card, play it on the discard pile.
• If you cannot play, you must draw one card from the draw pile.
• If the drawn card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | You may play multiple cards in one turn only if you have a “Draw Two” or “Wild Draw Four” and you choose to stack them (house rule). | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. | “Wild Draw Four” can only be played if you have no other playable card (unless you’re playing with the “Stacking” rule). | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you have exactly one card left, you must shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. | If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. | That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards remaining in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. | Continue playing rounds until someone reaches the target score (usually 500). | | **House Rules (optional)** | • **Stacking** – Players can stack “Draw Two” or “Wild Draw Four” cards instead of drawing.
• **No “Wild Draw Four” if you could play a normal card** – enforce stricter play.
• **Penalty for not calling UNO** – draw 2 or 4 cards. | These rules add variety; agree on them before starting. | --- ### Quick Play Summary 1. **Deal** 7 cards each. 2. Flip top card → discard pile. 3. Clockwise play: match color/number/symbol or play a Wild. 4. Special cards affect the next player. 5. When you’re down to one card, shout “UNO!”. 6. Finish the round by discarding all cards. 7. Score points; first to 500 wins. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
